title: How Is Money Actually Created? It's Not What You Think
short_title: Banks create money when they lend? 💸 #shorts
description:
Most people think money is simply printed by the government. In reality, most money is created by commercial banks when they make loans, and it disappears when loans are repaid. Here is how it works, step by step, with the role of central banks, interest rates and the limits on lending. Educational content only, not financial advice.
